# Proof & State

> Proof & State builds tools that help teams use AI in software delivery with clearer boundaries, reviewable changes and evidence that can be checked independently.

Proof & State is an independent engineering project. The public website describes product outcomes and current availability without exposing implementation-only workflow labels.

## Products

- **DoneState**: reviewable repository maintenance. It helps prepare selected maintenance work as branches and pull requests while repository owners keep the final merge decision. Live service: https://donestate.proofandstate.com. MCP: https://donestate.proofandstate.com/mcp. Source: https://github.com/AyobamiH/donestate
- **OpsTruth**: independent software evidence checks. It inspects repository and delivery evidence without changing the system it checks. Website: https://opstruth.io. MCP: https://mcp.opstruth.io/mcp. GitHub Marketplace: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/opstruth-evidence. Source: https://github.com/AyobamiH/opstruth
- **AgentProof**: in development. Its current purpose is to create checkable evidence around consequential AI-assisted actions. Its contract is defined, but downstream release work remains. Source: https://github.com/AyobamiH/agentproof

## Current status

- Proof & State website is live at https://proofandstate.com.
- DoneState is live on its owned service domain. DoneState 0.2.0 remains in OpenAI review, and its GitHub Marketplace listing is also under external review. Neither review state is approval or public listing there.
- OpsTruth is publicly available as the opstruth-evidence GitHub Marketplace Action. Version v1.0.0 and the stable v1 reference were published on 30 August 2026.
- AgentProof is in development and is not presented as a released product.
- No uptime percentage or service-level commitment is published on the website.

## Accuracy notes

- The site does not claim customers, partnerships, funding, certifications, audits, compliance attestations, adoption numbers or uptime guarantees unless evidence is deliberately published.
- Product maturity is literal: live service, public marketplace availability, external review and in development are not treated as interchangeable.
- Historical review transports, internal runtime state names, application identifiers, installation identifiers, sample hashes and implementation-only workflow labels are intentionally omitted from this public retrieval file.
